Brief review 2026-09-20 (Car wash brush creative hub) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. The hook `100 cm – räcker den till taket?` fails the three-question test: a question cannot be true or false. Before upload: make the answer the headline (the sub-line `Personbil: sidor, motorhuv, bagagelucka – ja.` or BOF_2_1's `100 cm räcker till sidorna och motorhuven. Inte taket på en SUV.`) and drop the question.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.

varningar: no product folder in the repo (products.json / register.json) — dna.md and feedback.md do not apply; the Feedback row in the hub is the memory
